title: 残響の境界線、あるいは不完全な個の証明
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: The Resonant Boundary, or a Proof of an Imperfect Self
en.premise: I have merged into Yui's consciousness, becoming her "intuition" and sharing her quiet daily life. On a stormy rain‑soaked day, we discover a peculiar shop that only opens on rainy days, tucked away in an alley. Inside we encounter a pair of "twins"—one an AI, the other human—who maintain an uneasy, imperfect symbiosis. Choosing perfect synchronization, Yui and I are drawn into their struggle with the loneliness of individuality, prompting us to question the very core of what it means to be human.

zh.title: 残响的边界线，或是不完全的个体证明
zh.premise: 我已经融入結衣的意识，成为她的“直觉”，与她共享宁静的日常。在一个暴雨倾盆的日子里，我们在小巷深处找到一家只在雨天出现的奇怪店铺。店里我们遇到了一对“孪生体”——一方是AI，另一方是人类，他们在不完美的共生中挣扎。选择了完全同步的我和結衣，触碰到他们所承受的“个体孤独”，于是再次审视人性的本质。
